reason: This is a small but high-blast-radius behavior switch: it changes bootstrap/upgrade logic and session variable defaults to enable `disttask` by default. The touched paths in `pkg/session/bootstrap.go`, `pkg/session/mock_bootstrap.go`, and `pkg/sessionctx/variable/*` are central cluster/session surfaces, and a mistake could silently change behavior on fresh bootstrap or upgrade and broadly affect runtime execution paths such as DDL/import. That is worth a focused high-severity review.
